note: Written before reading any of the seven reports, from my own measurements of the artifacts as this session captured them. The rule is the lower of critic and builder per category, so a number here is a ceiling on what I claim. Last cycle three floors were met and on all three the critic and I agreed to the point; the two that bind are the two the critic held down, so these are written from measurements rather than from caution.

messenger_reliability.why: Every seeded scene is paired and connected against a far phone carrying the same year — link connected on all eleven, 14,062 to 14,114 events each — and the records now describe the pictures they are named after: `shot` reads the app's own report immediately before it opens the shutter, so a report that says `at: 13_messenger_states.png` is an account of that picture and says which of the two moments it is. 13 carries read, sent, refused and taken back in the picture's own words, because the report asks the same function the glass does. 14 reads 0:01 of 0:03 with a hold mark, the played part inked and the playhead a third along, and its record agrees to the millisecond (playing, 921 ms of 2500) — it read 0:00 of 0:11 over a two-and-a-half-second clip last cycle, because twenty seed payloads declared lengths the renders never had; the index is written from the render now and seed/tools/validate.py fails on the next drift. 11 is 300 frames with none held and none of them a light jump, and its timings were taken on a quiet machine: build p50 5 ms, p95 773, max 1109, raster 117-200. Held down, hard, by what those spikes are: a sync round on a year-deep spine walks all 14,073 events looking for missing blobs, so the phone spends most of each cycle not listening — a typing frame from the other phone took 9111 ms to cross a loopback socket with the harness asking every 250 ms, and 13 shows no `noor writing…` because the six-second lapse ran out first. Also by the second device, which is missing; by transport: local with no key; and by a first launch that still costs thirteen seconds.

material_truth.why: The pale one-pixel rule on the wood is gone, and it is gone because it was found rather than guessed at for a sixth time. tools/check/hairline.py reads all ten stills and counts zero bright one-row runs of 60 px or more on the desk; nine of ten carried them for five cycles, 9 to 83 each, the longest 1245 px. It was the mask's own edge: ShaderMask multiplies a tear in by drawing a rectangle the size of the child in dstIn, and that rectangle is antialiased, so on the row where a piece's box falls between two device pixels the blend lands at partial coverage and a third of a pixel of sheet survives where the tear had erased it — α = 0.333 / 0.335 / 0.336 solved on the three channels at 02_chat y=200, x=1200. A bisect in the browser, six builds against a far phone of its own: 29 runs as captured, 29 without mipmaps on the mask shader, 29 with the mask composed at the piece's exact height, 29 with the rotation filtered differently, 29 with the lit-fibre overlay off, 1 with the mask taken out of the piece, 0 with the mask rectangle two pixels wider. The torn edge and its contact shadow are unchanged beside it. Beyond that: 258 surfaces in the library, none flat, none unlit; the hero frames eight sheets on eight distinct torn edges out of fifty-six; the hand's twin share on the hero is 0.061 at IoU 0.85, against 0.147 and 0.167 the last two cycles, with a median best-fit IoU of 0.669. Held back by the WebP ceiling under every one of those numbers, by eight feeling objects that are still flat-lying sheets, by an ink plate that lives in the outline rather than in the ink, and because I have still never compared any of this paper with a photograph of real paper.

emotional_transmission.why: Her mood changing is a piece of paper going down on the desk now, not a swap: 08 is 518 frames with none of them identical to the one before, where the same clip had sixty-one — all of them in the run named for the thing the clip is named for, because the sheet used to rebuild with new words on new stock between two frames and then nothing moved. It lands from a little above over the sheet it replaces, which stays on the desk until it is covered and is then off the tree rather than left in it invisible, and a test fails if it goes between two frames again. 15 is 376 frames, none held, through the vocabulary family by family to the couple's own authored feeling. Thirty-four feelings, each with its own object under the same lamp as the paper; twelve partner signals and three ambient surfaces recorded as what was sent. Held back because nobody has felt a buzz — there is no vibrator in this session, so the haptic evidence is a table, a lane drawn to scale and the page's own rhythm — and by eight flat objects.

coherence.why: One spine and one store under every region, one codebase for the PWA and the Android host, and the reports are per region rather than the thread's rows described for every screen. What changed this cycle is that the evidence stopped disagreeing with itself: a record of a picture is read at the picture, so 13's report can no longer say the partner is not writing over a frame in which she is, and 14's can no longer name a length the player had not read; and three things that were written down wrong about the pale rule — a comment in paper.dart, a test that asserted it, a paragraph in docs/CONTINUE.md — say what was measured instead. Held back because only one of the two platforms has been run on a phone this session, and because the fifth module was added by the same hands that wrote the other four.

anti_goal.why: No engagement machinery of any kind: nothing counted, no streak, no badge, nothing that asks for a return. 119 displayed strings read against the eight rules in docs/VOICE.md, none against the voice. 258 rendered surfaces, none a flat fill, none unlit. And one thing the app was drawing that nothing on a desk does — a mathematically straight pale line on the wood beside every sheet — is measured at zero on all ten stills. Held back by the one thing I cannot measure: whether a reader sees photographed paper or a very good simulation of it.

what_i_will_not_argue_with: 09_two_devices.png and 16_setup_android.png are absent. No /dev/kvm; docs/PHONES.md measures the three routes tried; evidence/WHY_MISSING.json says so in the manifest and the diff rather than 'not captured this session'.
08 shows one screen. The far phone is the spine in the host role and has no screen by construction, and a browser page cannot take that role because the host binds a listening socket.
Every reliability report says transport: local. This session had no TS_AUTHKEY and the brief forbids asking again, so the tailnet run stays pending — not passing, not failing.

The vibrator is untested: there is no Android device here, so the haptic evidence is the pattern table, the lane drawn to scale, and the page rhythm — not a phone buzzing. The inversion fixed this cycle was found by reading, and it is the kind of thing only a phone can confirm.

The hand still repeats. 16.7 per cent of marks on the hero have a near-twin at IoU 0.85 by the app's own log; a critic measured 8.9 per cent at 0.99 under translation. Five variants a glyph is not enough for a screen with five hundred marks on it, and the fix is a font rebuild that has not run.
Paper is rendered as WebP at Blender's default quality before it is packed, so every downstream number is measured against an already-degraded ceiling.
Eight of the feeling objects are flat-lying sheets and stains; no lighting change puts a gradient on a plane.
The seeded photographs are renders and the darkest few read as renders.
I have not compared any of the paper with a photograph of real paper.

The hand still repeats. Sixteen point seven per cent of marks on the hero had a near-twin at IoU 0.85 by the app's own log last cycle; the lever is the variant count in tools/handwriting/hands.json and the font rebuild has not run.
A frame from the other phone takes nine seconds to cross a loopback socket. It is measured, it is in the sheet, and it is the first thing in the next cycle.

07_feeling_landing failed its own frame check twice before it passed, on the two sides of one moment: a sheet drawn before its tear had decoded, then a hole where the sheet was not drawn at all. The app is right to wait for its paper; the scene was filming too early, and it waits for the app to finish putting the sheet down now. The clip in the set is the third shot of it.

declined.finding: Make the desk less directional, so its across-grain to along-grain ratio approaches paper's.
declined.reason: A quartered oak board is directional by construction and a sheet of paper is not. The pores and the lens-shaped ray fleck are in, and measured the critic's own way — eighty 64-pixel windows of bare desk — they move the ratio from 5.23 to 5.18. I predicted the two remaining levers on the albedo before spending another render: 5.28 with the fleck at half again, 5.75 with a stronger fibre. Nothing reaches 0.63 without weakening the growth rings, and the growth rings are what make it read as oak.
